{{Quote|The planetoid is barely habitable, with a breathable atmosphere.|[[Osten Dal'Nay]]|<ref name="Decision: Almas">{{LivingForce|Decision: Almas}}</ref>}}
A '''small planetoid''' was located in the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]]. It had a pale blue-colored breathable atmosphere and the only forms of life that lived there were some plants and fungi. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] established a [[Separatist Ando system base|base]] there, but they were driven out of it when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Mission to the Ando system|attacked]] the facility in about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].
